title: BETA Guardian MCP Server Tools
description: Guardian oversight tools for senior citizen safety: requesting approvals, checking approval status, emergency alerts, and retrieving safety rules.

tools.name: request_guardian_approval
tools.description: Trigger a Guardian WhatsApp authorization workflow when an errand or transaction exceeds the household auto-limit.

payee_name.description: Name of the merchant, utility, or payee.

reason.description: Optional voice reason spoken by parent (e.g. 'monthly diabetes tablets refill').

tools.name: check_approval_status
tools.description: Check whether Arjun (Guardian) has approved or rejected a pending transaction via WhatsApp.

approval_id.description: The unique approval ID generated by request_guardian_approval.

tools.name: send_guardian_alert
tools.description: Send an immediate WhatsApp high-priority security alert to the guardian (e.g. suspected scam coercion, nighttime attempts).

alert_type.description: Classification of the security or health incident.

tools.name: get_household_rules
tools.description: Retrieve current guardrail policies (auto limit, max ceiling, curfew hours, cooling-off duration, frozen state).
